action: No BS4 vehicle goes on any Delhi NCR route.
source_quote: October to February, no BS4 vehicle goes on any Delhi NCR route.

action: Vehicle must have an engine heater and no brake work in the last thirty days.
source_quote: The vehicle must have an engine heater... I never send a vehicle on a hill route if it has had any brake work in the last thirty days.
If a Shakti load crosses 36 hours... in my head Shakti is a 36 hour client.

condition: Vertex truck is going to reach after 6 pm
action: Hold it at the last halt, deliver next morning at 8.
source_quote: If a Vertex truck is going to reach after 6, don't let it reach after 6.

condition: Truck has any issue on an Apex run
action: Send a different vehicle at least once in between.
source_quote: If a truck has any issue on an Apex run... send a different vehicle at least once in between.

action: Never wait at a hub overnight unrefrigerated and always use the newest available vehicle, 2020 or later.
source_quote: Their loads never wait at a hub overnight unrefrigerated, and their consignments always get the newest available vehicle, 2020 or later.

condition: July to September, anything going east of Lucknow
action: Add twenty percent to whatever time the computer says.
source_quote: July to September, anything going east of Lucknow, add twenty percent to whatever time the computer says.

condition: Vehicle breaks down within 50 kilometers of its origin hub
action: Replacement comes from the origin hub.
source_quote: If a vehicle breaks down within 50 kilometers of its origin hub, the replacement comes from the origin hub.

condition: Vehicle is more than 30 days past its due service date
source_quote: Any vehicle that is more than 30 days past its due service date is grounded.

action: Must get a permanent repair within seven days.
source_quote: Whatever he patched must get a permanent repair within seven days.

condition: New drivers, less than six months with us
action: Never go solo on a night run.
source_quote: New drivers, less than six months with us, never go solo on a night run.
